[[File:Great rhombihexahedron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great rhombihexahedron]]
In [[geometry]], the '''great rhombihexahedron''' (or '''great rhombicube''') is a [[nonconvex uniform polyhedron]], indexed as U<sub>21</sub>. It has 18 faces (12 [[Square|squares]] and 6 [[Octagram|octagrams]]), 48 edges, and 24 vertices.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mathconsult.ch/static/unipoly/21.html|title=21: great rhombihexahedron|last=Maeder|first=Roman|date=|website=MathConsult|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> Its [[Duality (mathematics)|dual]] is the [[great rhombihexacron]].<ref>{{mathworld|urlname=GreatRhombihexahedron|title=Great Rhombihexahedron}}</ref>  Its [[vertex figure]] is a [[quadrilateral#More quadrilaterals|crossed quadrilateral]].

== Related polyhedra ==

It shares the [[vertex arrangement]] with the convex [[truncated cube]]. It additionally shares its [[edge arrangement]] with the [[nonconvex great rhombicuboctahedron]] (having 12 square faces in common), and with the [[great cubicuboctahedron]] (having the octagrammic faces in common).

{| class="wikitable" width="400" style="vertical-align:top;text-align:center"
|[[Image:Truncated hexahedron.png|100px]]<BR>[[Truncated cube]]
|[[Image:Uniform great rhombicuboctahedron.png|100px]]<BR>[[Nonconvex great rhombicuboctahedron]]
|[[Image:Great cubicuboctahedron.png|100px]]<BR>[[Great cubicuboctahedron]]
|[[Image:Great rhombihexahedron.png|100px]]<BR>'''Great rhombihexahedron'''
|}

It may be constructed as the [[exclusive or]] (blend) of three [[octagrammic prism]]s. Similarly, the [[small rhombihexahedron]] may be constructed as the exclusive or of three [[octagonal prism]]s.

=== Great rhombihexacron ===
{{Uniform polyhedra db|Uniform dual polyhedron stat table|grH}}
[[File:Great rhombihexacron.stl|thumb|3D model of a great rhombihexacron]]
The '''great rhombihexacron''' is a nonconvex [[Isohedral figure|isohedral]] [[polyhedron]]. It is the [[Dual polyhedron|dual]] of the [[uniform star polyhedron|uniform]] great rhombihexahedron (U<sub>21</sub>).<ref>{{mathworld|urlname= GreatRhombihexacron|title= Great rhombihexacron}}</ref> It has 24 identical [[antiparallelogram|bow-tie]]-shaped [[Face (geometry)|faces]], 18 [[Vertex (geometry)|vertices]], and 48 [[Edge (geometry)|edges]].

It has 12 outer vertices which have the same [[vertex arrangement]] as the [[cuboctahedron]], and 6 inner vertices with the vertex arrangement of an [[octahedron]].

As a surface geometry, it can be seen as visually similar to a [[Catalan solid]], the [[disdyakis dodecahedron]], with much taller rhombus-based pyramids joined to each face of a [[rhombic dodecahedron]].
